title: System Explorer collection page
description: One page of object summaries from a collection. Pagination is explicit: the server never silently truncates, the client never infers truncation. Shared $defs are duplicated from observation.schema.json deliberately so each schema file is standalone.

filters.description: The fact-equality filters that were applied, echoed back.

total.description: Total matching objects, when cheaply known.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when this page is the end.

facts.description: Summary subset of the object's facts, chosen per collection for list rendering and agent triage.

worst_opinion_level.description: Triage level for lists: ok = positively healthy, info = neutral/no opinion, warn/critical mirror the worst opinion derivable from this summary's own facts via the shared rule evaluator (src/system_explorer/agent/rules/). A rule needing a fact the summary does not carry evaluates on the full object only — a documented acquisition-cost decision per rule, never divergent thresholds.

depth.description: Tree depth for naturally hierarchical collections (block devices, mounts). Structural observation data, not presentation.
